ranges.name: ROM_SEGA_HEADER_EXTENDED_FIELDS
ranges.boundary: Completes the standard 0x100-byte Genesis header and ends immediately before reset-path code at 0x00000200.

ranges.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_STREAM_ALIGNMENT_PADDING
ranges.boundary: The byte is zero and separates the bounded mode stream ending at 0x001270A6 from the next presentation stream at 0x001270A8.

evidence: The header tail contains the standard ROM-end continuation, reserved fields, and the U region code at 0x000001F0.
The header tail is exactly the remaining 0x5C bytes through the conventional 0x000001FF boundary.
The scene-resource separator is a byte-uniform zero between two independently bounded stream owners.
